hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.mts) npx --no-install prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.py) python -m black "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; python -m isort "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac
FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$(basename -- "$FILE")" in .env|.env.*|*.env) printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Blocked: .env files must not be edited by Claude"}'; exit 2 ;; esac
